depiction.primary_object: open-top shopping cart on two wheels facing right
modifiers: right-pointing arrow inside the cart basket
depiction.composition: single object in side profile with central arrow

readings.meaning: checkout or complete online cart order
shopping cart or general online shopping

ambiguity: Can be confused with a plain shopping cart or 'add to cart' icon at small sizes if the arrow direction isn't distinguished from a plus or downward arrow.

reasoning: Shows a shopping cart with a forward-pointing arrow inside, universally understood as 'proceed to checkout' or completing an online cart order. It fits tasks centered on checking out a cart, placing a bulk/grocery order, or working on an ecommerce checkout flow, though tasks to buy a single specific item should use that item's icon instead.
